integration_constraints: Keep the Rev E rotation lines and link dimensions; any future change requires an explicit profile revision and FK comparison.
Use shared frames for shoulder/hip/torso/shoulder-girdle multi-axis joints. Do not stack 44 independent fork fixtures.
Shoulder datum plate in arm STEP is provisional and is not the shoulder joint.
Right-side asymmetric fasteners, sensors and cable routing require a separate mirrored assembly check.
